description: Corrected summary figure with nucleophile-motif windows fetched live from UniProt, plus the ortholog, geometry and first-shell panels
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

fam = [("LRAT",   "O95237","H60", "H72", 161),
       ("PLAAT1", "Q9HDD0","N42", "H30", 119),
       ("PLAAT2", "Q9NWW9","H23", "H35", 113),
       ("PLAAT3", "P53816","H23", "H35", 113),
       ("PLAAT4", "Q9UL19","H23", "H35", 113),
       ("PLAAT5", "Q96KN8","H145","H157",233),
       ("LRATD2", "Q96KN1","H132","H144",201),
       ("LRATD1", "Q96KN4","H143","H155",212)]
rows=[]
for nm,acc,h1,h2,p in fam:
    s="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=30).text.split("\n")[1:])
    rows.append((nm,acc,h1,h2,f"{s[p-1]}{p}",s[p-7:p+4]))
    print(nm, acc, "nucleophile", s[p-1], p, "window", s[p-7:p+4])
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["protein","uniprot","His1","His2","nucleophile","motif_window_pos-6_to_pos+4"]
            ).to_csv("nucleophile_motif_windows.csv",index=False)

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(17.5, 11.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.42, wspace=0.26)

axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
axA.set_xlim(0, 4.8); axA.set_ylim(-0.5, len(rows))
for i,(nm,acc,h1,h2,nu,mot) in enumerate(rows):
    y = len(rows) - 1 - i
    axA.text(-0.08, y, nm, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=11,
             fontweight="bold" if nm.startswith("LRATD") else "normal")
    for j, v in enumerate([h1, h2, nu]):
        bad = (j < 2 and v[0] != "H") or (j == 2 and v[0] != "C")
        axA.add_patch(Rectangle((j*0.72+0.05, y-0.33), 0.64, 0.66,
                      facecolor="#e8554e" if bad else "#9ecae1", alpha=0.9, edgecolor="grey"))
        axA.text(j*0.72+0.37, y, v, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10,
                 color="white" if bad else "black", fontweight="bold" if bad else "normal")
    axA.text(2.35, y, mot, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=11, family="monospace",
             color="#b2182b" if "SESF" in mot else "black")
for j, c in enumerate(["His 1","His 2","nucleophile"]):
    axA.text(j*0.72+0.37, len(rows)-0.35, c, ha="center", fontsize=10, style="italic")
axA.text(2.35, len(rows)-0.35, "window around the nucleophile", ha="left", fontsize=10, style="italic")
axA.axis("off")
axA.set_title("A. The two catalytic histidines are kept, the nucleophilic cysteine is not\n"
              "windows taken live from UniProt; red = departs from the active-enzyme residue",
              fontsize=12, loc="left")

axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
orth = [("Homo sapiens",100.0),("Canis lupus familiaris",99.3),("Sus scrofa",99.0),
        ("Bos taurus",98.3),("Equus caballus",97.3),("Rattus norvegicus",96.2),
        ("Mus musculus",95.9),("Gallus gallus",84.4),("Sarcophilus harrisii",83.2),
        ("Alligator mississippiensis",76.8),("Latimeria chalumnae",73.6),
        ("Xenopus tropicalis",72.8),("Ornithorhynchus anatinus",68.1),
        ("Danio rerio",64.6),("Oryzias latipes",64.6),("Takifugu rubripes",63.0)]
axB.imshow(np.ones((len(orth),4)), cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=2, aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(orth)):
    for j, r in enumerate(["H","H","C","S"]):
        axB.text(j, i, r, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10,
                 fontweight="bold", color="#b2182b" if j == 3 else "black")
axB.set_xticks(range(4)); axB.set_xticklabels(["His143","His155","Cys208","Ser212"], fontsize=10)
axB.set_yticks(range(len(orth)))
axB.set_yticklabels([f"{s}  ({p:.1f}%)" for s, p in orth], fontsize=9)
axB.set_title("B. Invariant in 16 of 16 vertebrate orthologs, human to fugu\n"
              "percent identity to human LRATD1 in brackets", fontsize=12, loc="left")

axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
pairs = ["His1 N to nucleophile\n(ND1 to OG / SG)", "His1 to His2 dyad\n(NE2 to ND1)",
         "His2 to nucleophile\n(NE2 to OG / SG)", "nearest other Cys SG\nto nucleophile atom"]
lr=[3.12,2.86,8.46,11.26]; p3=[3.87,2.72,8.56,0.00]
x=np.arange(4); w=0.38
axC.bar(x-w/2, lr, w, label="LRATD1 (AlphaFold)", color="#e8554e")
axC.bar(x+w/2, p3, w, label="PLAAT3 (crystal 4DOT)", color="#4393c3")
for xi,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(lr,p3)):
    axC.text(xi-w/2, a+0.25, f"{a:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
    axC.text(xi+w/2, b+0.25, f"{b:.2f}" if b else "0 (it is the Cys)", ha="center", fontsize=9)
axC.set_xticks(x); axC.set_xticklabels(pairs, fontsize=9)
axC.set_ylabel("distance (angstrom)", fontsize=11); axC.legend(fontsize=10); axC.set_ylim(0,13.5)
axC.set_title("C. The catalytic geometry is preserved, the thiol is absent\n"
              "89 CA pairs superposed, RMSD 1.34 A; Ser212 CB sits 1.76 A from Cys113 CB",
              fontsize=12, loc="left")

axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
fsres=[("Cys113","Ser212",0.918,True),("His23","His143",0.572,False),
       ("Asn112","Asn211",0.802,False),("Glu114","Glu213",0.996,False),
       ("Trp24","Trp144",0.983,False),("Phe116","Phe215",0.995,False),
       ("His35","His155",0.951,False),("His115","Ser214",0.862,True)]
y=np.arange(len(fsres))[::-1]
axD.barh(y,[v for *_ ,v,_ in [(a,b,v,s) for a,b,v,s in fsres]],
         color=["#e8554e" if s else "#4393c3" for *_,s in [(a,b,v,s) for a,b,v,s in fsres]])
for yi,(a,b,v,s) in zip(y,fsres):
    axD.text(v+0.01, yi, f"{v:.3f}", va="center", fontsize=9)
axD.set_yticks(y); axD.set_yticklabels([f"{a} -> {b}" for a,b,_,_ in fsres], fontsize=10)
axD.set_xlim(0,1.12)
axD.set_xlabel("AlphaMissense mean pathogenicity at the LRATD1 residue", fontsize=10.5)
axD.set_title("D. PLAAT3 first shell mapped onto LRATD1: two substitutions, six conserved\n"
              "red = substituted; the pocket residues stay under strong missense constraint",
              fontsize=12, loc="left")

fig.suptitle("Human LRATD1 (FAM84A, Q96KN4) keeps an intact LRAT-fold pocket and carries a serine "
             "where the catalytic cysteine belongs", fontsize=14, y=0.985)
plt.show()
